decisions.reason: As a recently launched extension of the core coolant-management range that stayed visible through 2024, it fits the firm's stated strategy and past engineering investment, so management would likely continue backing it rather than admit failure after only a short market period.

This centrifuge builds directly on the firm's established offer and supports its modular, efficient production promise, so with R&D and market-commitment already made and no clear evidence of failure, management would likely persist.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's core conveying business and helps round out a broad systems portfolio, making it likely that management justifies continued support on the basis of strategic fit, invested resources and the possibility that adoption is still ramping up.

Because the hinged belt chip conveyor remains on the website after launch, complements the firm's automation and material-flow business, and likely shares development and sales infrastructure with existing products, management would be inclined to keep it and attribute any weak uptake to temporary market factors.
